title: Sabbath
summary: The Sabbath was a covenant sign and weekly rhythm of rest, worship, and remembrance for Israel.
background: By the first century, Sabbath observance was often surrounded by detailed debates about what counted as lawful work. The Gospels show Jesus confronting distorted uses of Sabbath regulation while revealing mercy and lordship.
teachingHelp: When teaching Sabbath conflicts, distinguish God’s good command from human traditions and show how Jesus reveals the Sabbath’s true purpose.
sources: Alfred Edersheim, Sketches of Jewish Social Life in the Days of Christ (1876).
International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
